scope: Bounded whole exterior interpretation of the 2010 completed design; no surveyed dimensions, current-condition claim or architect endorsement.

source_comparison_method.plans: A09 complete RF, 1F and 2F inspected. Final upward-facing material triangles projected and visually registered to RF; independently reloaded final STL z=2.5 mm section registered to 1F. Manual affine placement checks exterior relationships, not a surveyed scale or invented pixel-similarity score.
source_comparison_method.roof_findings: Both complete envelopes, unequal terminations, relative spacing, main planted/paved regions and long roof-return cuts correspond to the source. Small steps, exact curvature and paving seams are generalized.
source_comparison_method.ground_findings: Main enclosure footprints are inset from the roof edges, with independent open canopy support ends; the visitor interior rooms and auditorium are intentionally not recreated.
source_comparison_method.second_level_limit: A diagnostic z=10.5 mm mesh section was compared with 2F for enclosure/roof distinctions. It is NOT an exact occupied-floor footprint; visitor drawing-level roof marks do not establish a complete occupied second storey.
source_comparison_method.photographs: A01 completed roof oblique and A03/A04 completed exterior/canopy views cross-check roof slope, soffit openings, basin and material families. A05/A06 local views inform curved concrete vocabulary without fabricating unregistered fine details. A07 project sheet cross-checks the complete composition.
source_comparison_method.elevation_direction_limit: View names follow the five source panel labels; model coordinate axes are not independently surveyed geographic azimuths.

five_elevation_correspondences.observed_correspondence_and_limits: High lakeward body, opaque inward face with slit/access relief, long roof descent toward inland; minor entrance openings generalized.
Two-level glazing at high end, shorter upper enclosure and low inland roof approach; not a continuous occupied two-level strip.
Rounded high concrete support, inward opaque face and curving soffit above the return, low descending tail.
Predominantly one glazed level under a curved high end, transitioning into a long inland descent.
Asymmetric whole lakeward composition: administration two-band facade, central open passage and lower visitor wing; grey source ground band is not modelled as a giant podium.

render_views.finding: Complete lakeward composition: taller two-band administration facade on the left, genuinely open nested canopy sequence in the middle, lower visitor facade on the right; no high uniform podium.
Both complete unequal roof envelopes, inland descents, independent long recessed returns, water basin and court visible together. Whole context lies within the image frame.
Opaque inward wall, long horizontal slit, curved lakeward support/soffit and descending inland roof retained. Glazing is not pasted over the whole inner elevation.
Two glazed bands and shorter upper facade under the downward roof, with lower approach toward inland tip. Reduced mullion rhythm and normalized heights.
Opaque inward service/retaining face, rounded high end, curved canopy underside and long descending approach. No invented full second-storey curtain wall.
Single dominant glazed facade below curved high roof and a long low inland descent. Mullions, doors and minor relief simplified.

Actual final-mesh material regions show pointed administration approach and broader rounded visitor return, planted fields, pale paving strips and distinct access recesses; no mirrored wing substitution.
Deliberately cropped detail of the actual two open canopy voids, distinct concrete support ends and basin crossing. It is not an exact reproduction of A04 camera position.
Actual final geometry cut at model z=2.5 mm shows both main enclosures, detached canopy support ends, open circulation, water and court. It is a geometric diagnostic, not an interior floor plan.

palette: Eight original flat material colours approximate visible concrete, glazing, planting, paving, water and recess families; not calibrated true colour, source-photo textures or baked source shadows.
accepted_minor_approximations: Exact curved soffit and roof profiles are not derivable from construction sections supplied here.
Glazing bars, local openings, doors, small levels, paving seams, rails and drainage are simplified.
Thin planar base closes the display model only; surrounding terrain, parking, interiors, vegetation objects and distant scenery are omitted.
framing: All eight overview/orthographic/section views tested against actual used mesh vertices and inspected without unintended model clipping. Canopy detail is intentionally cropped.
